notes: Room-first composition: full-room concept beside the playable version; fixtures derived from that concept.
Proposed 3 × 3; all twelve one-tile wall sections remain legal doors.
One fixed appearance at upgrades 1–5: room.gift_shop appearanceChanges=false.
Necessary furniture isn't removed by doors: joined checkout/main display and all four standing/queue spots remain.
Optional stocked wall bays, side runs and entrance endcap hide for their owned doors; the floor mat is walkable.
Joined plinths line the walls; stock overlaps by floor depth. One loop aisle connects all doors, displays, checkout and both queue spots.
Three default unchanged approved adult stills; fourth adult proves the full two-person queue. No staff.
Isolated owner review only: no runtime, income, balance, clinical or save changes.
